FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: AI Detects Bullish Momentum Above MA20 with Overbought RSI
tldr_points: Strong Australian jobs data boosts risk‑on sentiment, supporting USD demand.
Oil price rise from Iran strikes and port blockades fuels inflation expectations, lifting US yields.
PBOC’s higher USD/CNY fixing signals USD strength, reinforcing bullish bias for USD/JPY.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY trades above MA20 at 163.06, RSI overbought; oil‑driven USD strength supports upside toward 163.80.
FX.comment: Bullish bias supported by price above MA20, oil‑driven USD strength and PBOC fixing, despite overbought RSI.

STOCKS.title: [S&P 500] UP: Earnings Strength Supports Modest Upside
tldr_points: S&P 500 Q2 earnings beats at 5-year highs signal robust corporate growth.
Price sits just above MA20 with RSI near neutral, indicating mild bullish momentum.
AI-driven tech strength offsets softness in Google/Tesla, supporting upside bias.
STOCKS.excerpt: S&P 500 holds above MA20 on solid earnings; mild upside bias with defined risk levels.
STOCKS.comment: Price above MA20 with solid earnings backdrop supports a long bias.

CRYPTO.title: [BTC/USD] UP: Price Holds Above MA20 as Miner Strength Offsets Regulatory Noise
tldr_points: BTC trades 2.8% above rising MA20 with RSI at 65.6, signaling healthy momentum.
Hut 8 target raise validates miner transition thesis; Kraken expansion supports exchange tokenization flow.
Regulatory friction (Clarity Act, GOP bill) caps upside but fails to break structural support.
CRYPTO.excerpt: BTC sustains break above MA20 at $64k; bullish miner equity action counters DC regulatory drag.
CRYPTO.comment: Bullish trend intact above MA20; miner equity strength and tokenization flows offset regulatory overhang.
